title: elaphoglossum sellowianum
intro: Elaphoglossum sellowianum, commonly known as Sellow's elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. The health benefits of Elaphoglossum sellowianum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve antioxidant levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
